question: Which article of the Indian constitution mentions that it is duty of the Union government to protect States against external aggression and internal disturbance?
solution:
The correct answer is __355.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:**__

 
• Article 355 states, "It shall be the duty of the Union to protect every State against external aggression and internal disturbance and to ensure that the Government of every State is carried on in accordance with the provisions of this Constitution.”
 
• Part 18 of the Indian Constitution defines the Article.
